summary: Phase 1B Turn C — Marker Review Modal frontend E2E verified end-to-end on the Paloma template (7 occurrences · 5 pages). All 15 required scenarios pass: modal open, PDF render, occurrence selection + page nav + token_bbox indicator, property panel (alignment / size override / min size), per-marker preview refresh, add + delete new occurrence, cancel-add path, zoom in/out, page prev/next, whole-doc preview PDF download, close via X button, close via backdrop click, admin-template-detail regression, and the critical token_bbox drag invariant (class pointer-events-none, coordinates unchanged after 200px drag attempt).
action_items: OPTIONAL / DOC-ONLY: The review_request expected zoom sequence '140% → 180% → 100%' (2× zoom-in then 3× zoom-out). Actual step size in code is 0.2 (=20%), so the observed sequence is 140% → 180% → 120%. Behaviour is internally consistent (same step in both directions) and matches the on-screen indicator; only the problem-statement narrative is slightly off. No code fix required unless the intended step is 0.4 (=40%).

OPTIONAL / DEV-PREVIEW NOISE: A React hydration warning ('In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>') is emitted by the Emergent preview instrumentation wrapping <option> children in <span data-ve-dynamic> inside the mr-add-code-select. This is generated by the preview environment's code-inspection layer (x-file-name/x-component/x-source-var attributes), not by MarkerReviewModal.jsx itself, and will not appear in the production build. Safe to ignore — no functional impact observed.
critical_code_review_comments: MarkerReviewModal.jsx is 732 lines — near the 700-line soft cap. Consider splitting MarkerBox / MarkerPropertyPanel / SubstitutionAckPanel / OccurrenceList / BulkAckConfirm / DeleteConfirm into their own files under src/pages/marker_review/ for future maintainability. Not blocking.

handleCanvasClick fires on every click on the overlay layer (including clicks that Rnd.stopPropagation misses on the label div at -top-4). In practice we observed clean behaviour, but a defensive `if (e.target !== overlayRef.current) return;` would prevent accidental Add-mode drops when clicking on a marker's own label.
The per-marker preview PNG refresh (mr-preview-refresh) re-fetches with a cache-busting `_t=Date.now()` — good. Works reliably; ~1s LLM/render latency observed.
token_bbox invariant is correctly enforced via absolute-positioned div with pointer-events-none + zIndex 6 (Rnd is 7/8). Verified programmatically: 200px drag attempt produced 0px displacement.
Backdrop click on ModalShell correctly checks `e.target === e.currentTarget` to avoid closing when clicking inner content.
seed_data_creation: None — added then deleted one FRANCHISEE_ADDRESS_BLOCK occurrence on page 1 during testing; final occurrence count back to 7 (verified).
